verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs describe multiple AI-driven automations (auto-receipt capture with AI-filled memos, AI-powered contract/screenshot intake, automatic invoice matching/coding, hotel rate monitoring/rebooking) that function like delegated AI tasks, but there is no evidence of a single unified conversational 'AI assistant' persona inside the product that a user explicitly delegates arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a named in-product assistant/chat interface, evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond fixed automations, and independent hands-on confirmation of assistant-style interaction.
